# Dragoon's Town v0.21

Explore distinct districts and bring more life to the streets and waterfront. Your existing cash, businesses, collection, investments, prestige and saved progress stay intact.

- Downtown, Industrial, Entertainment, Luxury and Financial now have their own illustrated maps. Visit unlocked districts from the town selector, tap their permanent ventures, and preview Buy 1 or MAX costs before expanding.
- Close business or venture details with Close, empty ground or Escape to explore the town.
- Condemned locations show boarded windows, cracked walls, vines and rubble. A first purchase clears the rubble and reveals the restored building in a short animation; earning starts immediately. Repeated upgrades and already-owned saves do not replay construction.
- The existing getting-started tutorial explains restoration. A small Guide button opens it; completed/skipped guides stay completed. Show me where and pinned business goals return to the correct town location without buying it.
- More shaded citizens walk the paths, accompanied by dogs and cats. Small fish swim in waterfront districts, and improved sailboats/yachts occasionally cross the harbor. Inland maps do not show boats or fish.
- Low/Full activity, Pause, reduced motion and battery saver keep movement optional. All activity and restoration stop cleanly for menus, background/native pause and hidden states.
- Portrait/landscape layouts keep readable prices and direct purchase controls. The ordinary economy, milestone spacing, offline earnings and prestige rules remain unchanged.

No real payments, advertisements or real financial trading were added.

Android: compatible update for the existing app, version code 10, minimum SDK 24 (Android 7). Android 13 remains supported. Use More → App updates → Check now without uninstalling. Preview builds remain a separate app, not an update.

Verification evidence is in `docs/validation-v021.md`. Automated browser and build checks do not replace physical Thor/Android 13 installation, touch, sustained performance or accessibility testing.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex.
